Who's on shift?

🐈‍⬛☕

Running the café

  • 🐈Three cats have agreed to run a pop-up café. None of them asked what that involves.
  • ☕🍰🤵Barista makes it, Server carries it, Host seats the guests. That's the whole plan.
  • 🔀Someone clearly not coping? Drag their card to another role. The swap's instant. The improvement is a hope, not a promise.
  • ⏳The shift runs itself — opening, coffee rush, festival rush, last orders. Serve guests before they give up and keep the Café Mood up.
  • 😼It will not go smoothly. Perfect chaos is the target.
😼🍽️

Midknight's big problem

Pick five cats to fetch him home. (0 / 5)

😼

The situation

  • 😼Midknight overate at a visiting Cove's snack table and settled onto their cushion. He is not walking home.
  • 🐾Your five cats run over and drag his cushion back down the field to your cushion. The visitors won't let go — it's a tug the whole way.
  • 🐟Snack — a fish noses him your way. But every fish makes him heavier: more paws needed to shift him, and he sits down more.
  • 📣Rally — call your tired cats back to the cushion. The tug swings on who has fresher paws.
  • 🛏️Get him home before the festival closes. He'll sniff the cushion, turn around three times, and flop.
🏐

The rules, briefly

  • 🐈Your cats have agreed to play volleyball. Their commitment ends there.
  • 🏐When the ball comes over, tap the cat you want to go for it. They'll act like that was the plan.
  • 🥱Tap a yawning cat to keep them awake. Already asleep? Two taps. And perhaps a stern look.
